title: Activation Probe Robustness to Adaptive Adversaries: Can GCG Evade a Probe-Aware Attack?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Fundamental test of any proposed defense: does it survive adaptive adversaries? This is the gold standard for evaluating security mechanisms. If probes are brittle, the entire activation-based detection paradigm is questionable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires modifying GCG's loss function to include a probe-evasion term, which demands understanding of both GCG optimization and differentiable probe interaction. Custom adversarial optimization code is well beyond beginner ML scope.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Conceptually clean: one probe, one modified attack. But implementing the dual-objective GCG modification and debugging it is a significant engineering task that may stretch beyond 30 hours even for experienced developers.
